rubric.role_summary: Contract talent coordinator supporting day-to-day management of creators and influencers, including campaign deliverables, partner communications, accounting handoffs, and talent scouting.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Contract talent coordinator supporting day-to-day management of creators and influencers, including campaign deliverables, partner communications, accounting handoffs, and talent scouting.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 1+ years of social media marketing experience involving brand negotiation and deliverables, OR project management experience involving calendar invites and project management tools.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Knowledge of Hubspot and Canva.
- Experience working at an agency.
- Ability to analyze data and identify insights to assess campaign performance.
- Working knowledge of Google Workspace.
- Ability to work within strict branding guidelines.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: United States (remote). This is the role's single location rule: candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
